<!-- Generated by hack/docsgen from deploy/kustomize/crd/bases; do not edit. Run `make docs-gen`. -->

The `kudurru.io` kinds are the same documents in every deployment shape:
CRDs in Kubernetes (`kubectl apply`), and the objects of the sqlite store in a
single container (`kudurru apply -f`, `objects.d/`, the API and the UI). The
field tables are generated from the OpenAPI v3 schemas of the CRDs, so the
validation listed here is what the apiserver, and kudurru's own store
validator in Docker mode, enforce.

| Kind | Scope | Short names | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [BlockList](blocklist.md) | Namespaced | `blocklist` | BlockList is a named, refreshable set of block or allow entries. |
| [ClientGroup](clientgroup.md) | Namespaced | `cg` | ClientGroup names a set of clients so that Policies can target them. |
| [DHCPScope](dhcpscope.md) | Cluster | `dhcpscope` | DHCPScope is a DHCPv4 address pool served by kudurru in Kubernetes. |
| [DNSRecordSet](dnsrecordset.md) | Namespaced | `rrset` | DNSRecordSet is a set of records that belong to a DNSZone. |
| [DNSZone](dnszone.md) | Cluster | `zone` | DNSZone is a recorded grant of authority over a name space: the stone kept in the temple. |
| [Integration](integration.md) | Namespaced | `intg` | Integration configures background publication, inventory, or a webhook. |
| [Policy](policy.md) | Namespaced | `pol` | Policy applies lists, schedules and resolver settings to client groups. |
| [UnblockRequest](unblockrequest.md) | Namespaced | `ubr` | UnblockRequest is a user's request, made on the block page, to allow a blocked name. |
